mapper.select:
select d.id, d.name, d.age, d.sex, d.level_id, d.phone, d.type_id, d.hospital, d.updatetime, d.createtime, d.account_id, dl.id as dl_id, dl.name as dl_name, tt.id as tt_id, tt.name as tt_name from doctor d left join doctor_level dl on d.level_id = dl.id left join treat_type tt on d.type_id = tt.id
and ( d.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or dl.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tt.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by d.id asc

select d.id, d.name, d.age, d.sex, d.level_id, d.phone, d.type_id, d.hospital, d.updatetime, d.createtime, d.account_id, dl.id as dl_id, dl.name as dl_name, tt.id as tt_id, tt.name as tt_name from doctor d left join doctor_level dl on d.level_id = dl.id left join treat_type tt on d.type_id = tt.id where d.id = #{id}
select id, name from doctor_level order by id asc
select id, name from treat_type order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into doctor(name, age, sex, level_id, phone, type_id, hospital, account_id, createtime, updatetime) values (#{name}, #{age}, #{sex}, #{levelId}, #{phone}, #{typeId}, #{hospital}, #{accountId}, now(6), now(6))
